name: owlsetup-beta-foundations
description: Couche d'outillage qualite (lint, format, tests, catalogue externalise) pour OwlSetup. N'altere pas le comportement de l'application stable a la racine du depot.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run catalog:verify
scripts.catalog:verify: node scripts/build-catalog.mjs --check && vitest run test/catalog-schema.test.js test/catalog-parity.test.js
